headword: {九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}
reading: きゅうしにいっしょう

definitions.gloss: narrow escape from death; surviving against all odds
definitions.explanation: An idiom meaning to barely survive a life-threatening situation. Literally "one life out of nine deaths," expressing that the chance of survival was only one in ten.

examples.japanese: {九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。

⟦{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧、⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After narrowly surviving a traffic accident, I truly felt the preciousness of life.

examples.japanese: {登山中|とざんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雪崩|なだれ}→雪崩：05066_nadare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was caught in an avalanche while mountain climbing, but barely survived and was rescued.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the set phrase {九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain one life from nine deaths). A classical four-character idiom (yojijukugo) originating from Chinese. Used in both speech and writing to describe dramatic survival stories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to narrowly escape death)
- {九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (an experience of narrowly escaping death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}→危機一髪：06949_kikiippatsu⟧: a close call — a hair's breadth from danger; does not necessarily involve death
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧からがら: barely with one's life — emphasizes fleeing from danger
